<CLT=cltSYSTEM>And now, the
class trial has begun!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>As things progress during each class trial,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Nonstop Debates<CLT=cltSYSTEM> will occur.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>During <CLT=cltSTRONG>Nonstop Debates<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, characters will speak
one after another, <CLT=cltSTRONG>without pause<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>It's up to you to unearth any
<CLT=cltSTRONG>lies or contradictions<CLT=cltSYSTEM> in their statements.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You'll have to use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Truth Bullets<CLT=cltSYSTEM> you gathered
to <CLT=cltSTRONG>refute<CLT=cltSYSTEM> what they say.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Any relevant Truth Bullets you've found
during the investigation...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...will be loaded into the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Truth Cylinder<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Use the <PAD=【Ｌ３】> to aim the reticle
and fire with <PAD=【△】>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Aim for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>gold words<CLT=cltSYSTEM> displayed in their
statements. Those are the <CLT=cltSTRONG>weak spots<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>There's a chance that the <CLT=cltSTRONG>lies or contradictions<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
are hiding within those weak spots...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But remember, you might not be able to refute
them all, and you have to use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>right Truth Bullet<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Compare everyone's statements to the
Truth Bullets you have...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>And shoot your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Truth Bullet<CLT=cltSYSTEM> at the
proper weak spot.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Note that if you run out of <CLT=cltSTRONG>time<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, you will
automatically fail, so please be careful!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...Oh! I almost forgot!
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>new element<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>During the trial, you can <CLT=cltSTRONG>concentrate<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
to make time <CLT=cltSTRONG>slow down<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>This will also reveal a small red dot within 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>weak spots<CLT=cltSYSTEM> called the <CLT=cltSTRONG>V Point<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you hit that with the correct Truth Bullet, you'll get 
an awesome <CLT=cltSTRONG>V Counter<CLT=cltSYSTEM>! Bullseye!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>V Counters really improve your score and the
number of Monocoins you earn, so try that out.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>During the Nonstop Debate, <PAD=【Ｆ㊨】>
will bring up the <CLT=cltSTRONG>controls<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Give them a look!
